name: Hupemas Mugs 2023 Pack
description:
Happy Hupe-a-days! In celebration with the coolest, most creative, most artistic community in the hupe-ing world, we are so excited to share the Hupemas Mugs 2023 Pack with you! These mugs are sure to bring hugs and we are living 4 it. 




Owning this fun holiday pack brings you the following set of mugs to say GM (or GN) with. 

Hand: Reindeer Mug

Hand: XL Hot Cocoa

Hand: Christmas Tree Mug 



 All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).



As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io), it will automatically be available for use - enjoy, and happy Hupemas!
